card.name: Linking words after time spans
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, before, after and following that come right after an amount of time (minutes, weeks) and lead into an event like starting treatment or a meal. Also occasionally the word minutes itself.

modes.label: Word after minutes
modes.description: A preposition follows a number of minutes and links it to a treatment or meal event.

modes.description: Words about beginning or entering something, such as start or into, in procedural or trial text.
